# Highlights

*1007 PRs from 257 contributors.*

## New models

| Model | Type | Cookbook |
|---|---|---|
| Muse Spark Open | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Meta/MuseSparkOpen) |
| Beam-1.0 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Reflection/Beam-1_0) |
| MiniMax-M3.1-Flash | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/MiniMax/MiniMax-M3.1) |
| MiniCPM-V 4.7 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-4_7) |
| Kev | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Kev/kev) |
| Cosmos3-Nano-Sim (Bimanual, Transfer, Auto) | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Cosmos/Cosmos3) |
| FastH3 Omni | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3) |
| FLUX.3 Image Klein | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/FLUX/FLUX.3) |
| HY-Nomas | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/HY-Nomas/HY-Nomas) |
| MOSS-Image | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image) |

## What's new

* DeepSeek-V4.1 on GB300 gets up to 1.5x more prefill throughput under load and about 28% lower first-token latency on 32K to 64K prompts ([#44403](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44403), [#45059](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45059), [#45107](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45107)).
* SGLang low-latency mode: the opt-in NVIDIA [megakernel](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega) and AMD [monokernel](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono) plugins run DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode as fused persistent kernels, for up to 44% faster single-user decode on GB300 and 75% on MI350X ([#44945](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44945), [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450), [#44353](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44353), [#44621](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44621)).
* MoE models such as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash and gpt-oss reach the first token 30% to 58% sooner on 8K prompts on H200 ([#43363](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43363)).
* Paged Experts (opt-in) runs MoE models larger than GPU memory on a single consumer GPU, up to 30x faster than CPU offload ([#42557](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42557), [#45787](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45787)).
* SGLang now runs on Google TPU7x through [SGLang-TorchTPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu), a PyTorch-native plugin for TPU.
* You can now serve LoRA adapters on quantized MoE models (FP8 and NVFP4) with a new opt-in LoRA engine ([#45892](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45892)).
* DeepSeek-style MLA models running decode context parallelism can now keep their prefix cache in HiCache file-based L3 storage ([#41187](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41187)).

## To upgrade

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.23
```

| Platform | Docker |
|---|---|
| NVIDIA (CUDA 13) | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23` |
| AMD MI35x | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-rocm10-mi35x` |
| AMD MI30x | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-rocm10-mi30x` |
| Intel GPU | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-xpu` |
| Intel CPU | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-xeon` |
| Google TPU7x (TorchTPU) | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.1.0-tpu` |

# Full Release Notes

## Speculative Decoding

* [Fix] observability: Correct speculative FPM timing and decode lengths: [#38711](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38711)

* [Fix] spec: Remove `--speculative-skip-dp-mlp-sync`: [#45043](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45043)

# v0.33.0

## Highlights

This release features 927 commits from 389 contributors (122 new)!

* **New models**: Reflection Beam-1.0 (501B MoE, 23B active) with its DFlash2 drafter (#62074), Yandex AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B (#57963), Recursive Flint (40B MoE, 2.5B active) (#62938), Muse Spark Open (#61879), Step-5 Preview (#61727, #63147), NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super (#62957), Nemotron-Labs Dory1.0-4B (#60149), Nemotron Parse 3.5 (#61651), MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (#63095), Domyn Edge (#62544) and the ColUltraVBERT visual document retriever (#62237).
* **PyTorch 2.14**: vLLM is upgraded to PyTorch 2.14.0, with torchvision 0.29.0 and Triton 3.8.0 (#52183).
* **CUDA 12.9 dropped**: release wheels and images are CUDA 13.0 only. The CUDA 12.9 wheels and the `-cu129` / `-cu129-ubuntu2404` images are no longer published (#62575); use the default CUDA 13.0 artifacts instead.
* **libtorch ABI stable CUDA wheel**: the CUDA wheel is now ABI stable with libtorch.
* **AWS EFA image**: a new `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0-efa` image (x86_64 and aarch64) bundles the AWS EFA libraries and the EFA build of the Mooncake transfer engine, for KV transfer and multi-node serving on EFA-enabled EC2 instances (#58768).
* **`vllm/vllm` image alias**: every release image is now also published under the shorter `vllm/vllm` name, e.g. `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-efa` and `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-rocm`.
* **Speculative decoding**: the new XPress refiner for block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash and DSpark (#54448); FLy, an opt-in lossy verification policy with 1.04-1.31x decode throughput on MI355X and B300 (#53987); DFlash/DSpark no longer reserve draft slots in the token budget, taking DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + DSpark on GB300 from 1373 to 3390 output tok/s in the PR's benchmark (#59468); quantized draft `lm_head` (`draft_lm_head_quantization`, +18% decode at concurrency 1) (#59973); lookahead block hashes so EAGLE/MTP prefix-cache hits keep their last block, on by default (#61589); and MTP drafts in the Transformers modeling backend (#61270).
* **Faster decode on NVIDIA**: opt-in latency-specialized decode on GB300 for Kimi-K3 (1.5-2x at TP8/TP16, #61867) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (18.3% faster decode step at batch 1, #61868); DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 MXFP4 experts run as block FP8 through Humming on Hopper (+9-21% decode on 4x H200, #61875); FA4 sparse MLA decode on Blackwell (#55866); FlashInfer DCP prefill on trtllm-gen with 39-48% lower mean TTFT at 100k input on 8xB200 (#62029); and decode-only full CUDA graphs under MRV2 prefill context parallelism (2.6x over eager, #62377).
* **AMD ROCm**: the default ROCm image and wheels move to ROCm 10.0, with ROCm 7.2 still published as `-rocm72` (#58761); MonoKernel decode via `--monokernel` for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on MI300X/MI325X (2.32x P50 interactivity at concurrency 1, #60731) and on every MI355X layer (#61082), and for MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 on MI355X (16.6% lower TPOT, #62712, #62994); the `ROCM_OCTAVE` 3-4 bit KV cache (4.6x the KV tokens of fp16 on RX 7900 XTX, #59774); and gfx1250 enablement for gpt-oss-120b, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V4-Flash and MiniMax-M3 (#58800).
* **API and serving**: the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/decisions` endpoint, on by default for supported generation models (#60465, #61550); token embeddings with optional late chunking on `/v1/embeddings` (#61772, #63051, #60164); `output_mode="derender"` on `/inference/v1/generate` (#60082); a large Rust frontend parity push, including no more HTTP 500 on long conversations (#62374) and unsupported flags failing at startup (#62431); concurrent worker startup with TP > 1 (#60028); and a watchdog that dumps stack traces from stuck engine and worker processes (#55700).
* **Breaking changes**: Medusa and the MLP speculator removed (#61701); the legacy Ray compiled-graph executor removed (#61712, #62228); `--mamba-cache-mode` deprecated (#60043); requests sent while generation is paused now get HTTP 503 (#51488); the NIXL connector needs NIXL 1.5 or newer (#61032); LM Format Enforcer and `--ir-op-priority` deprecated (#63423, #63371).

## Release Artifacts

<!-- TODO: verify every URL and tag after publishing (wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.33.0/, wheels.vllm.ai/0.33.0/xpu, Docker Hub tags, GitHub release assets). -->

### Python Wheels

| CPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:v0.33.0` |
| XPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:v0.33.0` |

Every image is also available under the shorter `vllm/vllm` name: `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-efa`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-rocm` (`-rocm100`, `-rocm72`), `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-cpu` and `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-xpu`. `latest` works the same way, e.g. `vllm/vllm:latest-rocm`.

### Other Artifacts

Pre-built release artifacts are available in the **Assets** section at the bottom of this page, including:
- Source distribution tarball
- CUDA 13.0 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64
- CPU Python wheels for x86_64, arm64, and macOS
- XPU Python wheel for x86_64

## Model Support
* **New models**: Reflection Beam-1.0 (`BeamForCausalLM`) day-0 support with its DFlash2 drafter and fused Blackwell kernels (#62074, #62042), plus `beam` reasoning and tool parsers (#62052); Yandex AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B (Kimi Delta Attention hybrid, 512-expert MoE, 262K context) (#57963); Recursive Flint BF16 and NVFP4 GGUF checkpoints with small-batch Blackwell decode kernels (#62938); Muse Spark Open (#61879) with reasoning and tool parsers (#62207); Step-5 Preview (#61727, #62126, #62132), running on SM100 (#63147) with LoRA (#62498); NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super (#62957); Nemotron-Labs Dory1.0-4B (#60149); Nemotron Parse 3.5 with an MTP proposer on MRV2 (#61651); MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (#63095); Domyn Edge (#62544); ColUltraVBERT (#62237); LFM2.5-Embedding-350M (`Lfm2BidirectionalModel`, #62201); Kolibri 1 through the Transformers backend (#60827); and Decision 3.0 models (#61565, #61778) and Cloudflare Clef-Flash (#61308) on `/v1/systemone`.
* **DeepSeek-V4 and V4.1**: length-aware decode indexer block selection (about 850 us saved per step at 1M context, #61039); MegaMoE experts loaded directly in the DeepGEMM layout so `reload_weights` works (#60096); `fused_wqa_wkv` split by token across TP on SM90 (#58872); MegaAttn `wo_a` writes MXFP8 input for `wo_b` (#60118); native small-head FlashMLA sparse prefill on SM90 (#61615); FlashMLA interleaved KV layout (#61371); redundant EPLB expert slots loaded (#59611); GPU Engram tables read from peer HBM, fixing DEP decode hangs on GB200 (#62091); and fixes for Engram under PP (#62208), Engram all-to-all hangs (#62269), prefill index-workspace NaNs (#60613), C128 compressed-KV writes under PIECEWISE graphs (#59709), routed-expert rows under replay (#61643, #62652) and the updated 1017 reference encoding (#62199, #62200).
* **GLM**: GLM-5.3-Flash defaults to an FP8 KV cache (9.8% higher end-to-end throughput in the PR's benchmark, #61228) and gets mHC TileLang decode kernels on Blackwell (#62745); GLM-5.3 per-token-group quant (2.8% ITL, #60927), in-place draft decode metadata (#61873) and skipped `concat_and_cache_mla` scales (1.2-3.0% TPOT on B300, #62102); FP8 indexer WK pairs kept across `load_weights` calls, fixing thinking loops with runai_streamer (#59223).
* **Kimi-K3**: KDA RecoverSSM CuTe DSL verify/commit kernels on SM10x, with verify records moved out of the KV cache so KV connectors work (#63045); online quantization of NVIDIA projections (#62980).
* **Qwen**: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 QSA KV cache on Ampere (#60602, #60992), packed NVFP4 PLE embeddings that fit Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 on one DGX Spark (#56273) and PLE short-conv prefill checkpoints (#61601); FlashInfer GDN prefill checkpoints for Qwen3-Next / Qwen3.5 (#60050).
* **Other models**: Cohere2MoE attention/MoE dual stream, single TP all-reduce and fused add + RMSNorm (1.14-1.36x TPOT, on by default, #62101); Beam TP all-reduce fused with norms and MoE finalize (#62366); MiniMax-M3 CUTLASS MSA decode crossover (#55838); Granite MoE as an EAGLE3/DFlash/DSpark target (#61110); NemotronHMTP sharing target embeddings (#62194); LoRA for BERT cross-encoders and token classification (#61279, #61391).
* **Multimodal**: PaddleOCR-VL batched vision encoder (34-85% more throughput, #61458) and `compile_mm_encoder` (#61838); DeepSeek-VL2 ViT full CUDA graphs (#46005); Gemma4Unified batched embedding (#60643); Pixtral real-valued RoPE under compile (#63145); and fixes for EXAONE-4.5 images (broken since v0.29.0, #61104), Gemma 4 encoder graphs (#61365, #60687, #63538), DeepSeek-VL2 encoder cache and PP (#63120, #63192) and Gemma 4 placeholders (#61196).
* **Transformers modeling backend**: MTP speculative drafts (#61270), fused post-top-k MoE routers (#57410), graph caching instead of AOT caching (#58918) and dynamic-RoPE CUDA graphs (#58064).

## Engine Core
* **Speculative decoding**: XPress (#54448), FLy (#53987), no draft-slot budget reservation for DFlash/DSpark (#59468), quantized draft `lm_head` (#59973), lookahead block hashes (#61589), MRV2 skipping drafts no request can use (up to 7.3% prefill throughput with DFlash, #62784), Triton split-K verify (#56148), varlen Mamba2 decode for adaptive verification (#53036), and fixes for stop-trimmed token counts (#58668), block verification randomness (#61161), MTP block tables (#61174), grammar masks (#52477), EAGLE SWA prefix hits (#62206), DFlash/DSpark Mamba checkpoint reuse (#54163) and PP warmup (#62129).
* **Model Runner V2**: batch-sharded sampling for GPT-OSS (#61257) with adaptive verification (#58466), 31-120x faster long-prompt staged writes on GB200 (#62698), encoder towers skipped on later PP stages (0.58-1.27 GiB per stage, #60238), async scheduling kept for ngram (#62521), `input_ids` on later PP stages (#61016), and memory-profiling fixes (#57926, #58243, #61509, #63431).
* **Sampling**: Triton top-k/top-p skips the cutoff search for masked logits (up to about 8x, #61213); small-batch split top-p (1.22-2.70x on B300, #61996); and fixes for huge logits and boundary ties (#58231, #62046).
* **Startup and reliability**: concurrent local worker startup with TP > 1 (about 50s saved at TP8, #60028); shared Triton JIT compile pool (9-28% faster cold warmup, #61422); engine and worker watchdog (#55700); libgomp fork deadlock fixed (#62884); Fast Start with expert parallelism (#55490) and daemon fixes (#62583, #63451, #63088, #62734, #63506); and SHM broadcast reader memory growth fixed (#63165).
* **Memory and performance**: UVA-offloaded MoE experts on the sorted fused-MoE path (+7-19%, #62054); DispatchPooler bypass for homogeneous pooling (up to 10.3%, #62940); linear-time encoder cache free (#62850); sliding-window block tables null freed entries (#60767).
* **LoRA**: expert LoRA for MXFP4 MoE on `flashinfer_trtllm` (#61979), text-only LoRAs on multimodal wrappers (#62224), unsupported models rejected at validation (#61884), and fixes for `load_inplace` reloads (#41482), `max_loras` accounting (#60306), SM90 `lora_expand` NaNs (#61906) and wake-up from level-2 sleep (#62358).
* **RL**: per-choice `return_weight_versions` (#61347), NCCL M2N transfer with per-parameter meshes (#60934), parameter metadata sent once (#35911), the `ParamMeta` / `iter_full()` / `iter_local()` weight-transfer API (#63256), and a silent MoE weight corruption fix with packed NCCL transfer plus layerwise reload (#62555).
* **Batch invariance**: compressed-tensors W4A16/W8A16 (#60524), GateLinear routers (#59985), online FP8 MoE (#57092), and inductor batch-invariant mode under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT` (#61118).

## Large Scale Serving
* **Context parallelism**: MRV2 PCP decode full CUDA graphs (#62377); PCP for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with prefix caching and SWA bounded replay (#59857, #62183, #62384); FlashInfer DCP prefill on trtllm-gen (#62029); direct DCP all-to-all with strided LSE (#60373); FlashMLA sparse on the a2a DCP backend (#61285).
* **HiSparse**: direct reads of GPU-resident KV, fixing OOM with long prompts and a 3.3x slowdown on 1M-token prefill (#60417); faster host pool prefault (#60869); and P/D correctness fixes (#61659, #62739, #63827).
* **KV connectors**: NIXL 1.5 strided descriptors (#61032), sleep mode with the pull connector (#59635), mixed hybrid MLA block sizes (#61002) and GQA draft head sharding (#58471); Mooncake sleep mode over RDMA (#59625) and Prometheus metrics (#56939); MoRIIO hybrid and heterogeneous-TP WRITE transfers (#60544, #61726); streaming responses carry `kv_transfer_params` (#40186); fault tolerance extended to P/D, fixing KV block leaks (#56430).
* **KV offload**: CPU offload over up to 32 shm files (GLM-5.3 offload startup 63.6 s to 38.3 s, #59546), opt-in same-step small loads (#61961), EAGLE/MTP partial tails in align mode (#61019), lock/unlock and off-thread tiering (#58168), and many correctness fixes (#63266, #60810, #63652, #62929, #63010, #60574, #63655).
* **MoE and DP**: DeepEP-v2 fused decode globalize+align (up to 2.01x on H200 EP32, #53911); Elastic EP with an external load balancer (#43202); low-latency CPU all-reduce for DP syncs (#61767) and a DP wave hang fix (#59559); EPLB fixes for MXFP4/MXFP8 scales (#61786) and NIXL reads (#62081).

## Hardware & Performance
* **NVIDIA**: Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash latency-specialized decode on GB300 (#61867, #61868); FA4 sparse MLA decode (#55866); opt-in CuTe DSL MLA context prefill (#62069); DeepGEMM MegaMoE with NVFP4 routed experts (#61538) and warmed-up kernels (#60468, #61657); Triton GDN decode tuned on SM100 (#61355); GLM-5.2/5.3 low-latency BF16 GEMM on SM107 (#62843); pre-SM90 FlashInfer spec decode in full CUDA graphs (73.6 to 108.1 tok/s on SM80, #60532); `cooperative_topk` sized by row length (#62171); fused GDN MTP decode for SM80-SM90 in CUDA 12.x builds (#60896); and DGX Spark Qwen4Exp TP2 plans (#61437).
* **AMD ROCm**: ROCm 10.0 default image (#58761); MonoKernel decode for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and V4-Pro and MiniMax-M3 (#60731, #61082, #61482, #62712, #62994); `ROCM_OCTAVE` KV cache (#59774); gfx1250 enablement (#58800); DeepSeek-V4 MXFP4 indexer K cache by default on CDNA4 (up to 30.7% lower TTFT, #60834, #63669); AITER MegaMoE fixed-slot dispatch (14-15%, #61262) and shared-expert overlap (#61819); Kimi-K3 Gluon KDA kernels (#57392, #59552) and specialized decode (#60683); Qwen3.5 fused GDN MTP decode (+10-16% on MI350X, #61855); Qwen3.8-Flash-Next native W4A4 (1.9-2.3x, #60816); AITER top-k for sparse indexers on gfx950 (#61943); FlyDSL GDN prefill default on gfx942/gfx950 (#60645); RDNA3 TRITON_ATTN addressing restored (about 18%, #60084); and a MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 startup fix for very large GEMMs (#64567).
* **Intel XPU**: SYCL GDN prefill backend selection (#56835), torch MXFP4 linear backend (#51965), SYCL FlashAttention for prefix-LM text batches (#62014) and NIXL 1.5.0 in the image (#60356).
* **CPU**: zentorch 2.14.0.1 with float16 on Zen CPUs with AVX512-FP16 (#61411); MRV2 Triton warmup at startup removing an 11-20 s first-request compile (#62888); INT8 W8A8 MoE brgemm (#60740); hybrid-model prefix caching (#61805); and Run:ai Model Streamer in the CPU image (#61382).
* **Other**: tpu-infer

# Highlights

*950 PRs from 245 contributors.*

## New models

| Model | Type | Cookbook |
|---|---|---|
| Clef / Clef Flash | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Cloudflare/clef) |
| PPLX-Decider v1 / v1.1 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Perplexity/PPLX-Decider-v1.1-27B) |
| EmbeddingGemma 2 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Google/EmbeddingGemma2) |
| LLaDA2.2 | LLM / VLM | |
| HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Tencent/HunyuanImage3) |
| Kandinsky 6 / Kandinsky 6 SR | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Kandinsky/Kandinsky6) |
| Wan-Animate-2 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Wan/Wan-Animate-2) |
| SANA-Video 2.0 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/SANA-Video/SANA-Video) |
| LLaDA-Image / LLaDA-Image-Turbo | Diffusion | |

## What's new

* DeepSeek-V4.1 gets up to 2.3x more throughput per GPU on H200, and now runs on AMD MI350X / MI355X with up to 1.9x throughput from DSpark ([#41251](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41251), [#41308](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41308)).
* Qwen3.8-Flash-Next decodes 12% faster on B200, and GLM-5.3-Flash with DFlash 10% faster on B300 ([#42175](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42175), [#42489](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42489)).
* MiMo-V2.6-Pro gets 1.85x decode throughput with DFlash on B300 ([#41886](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41886)).
* Models load 10x faster with the new InstantTensor loader ([#40453](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40453)).
* PD disaggregation gets up to 27% more throughput and half the p95 TTFT on long-prompt workloads ([#40703](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40703)).
* HiSparse now supports EAGLE and MTP for long-context serving with the KV cache in CPU memory ([#37771](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37771)).
* GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3 can now combine decode context parallelism with MTP, with up to 2.1x faster decoding on GLM-5.3 ([#43735](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43735)).
* SGLang now runs on Apple Silicon Macs with the standard PyTorch backend, alongside MLX ([#36780](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36780)).
* MiniMax-H3 and Qwen-Image 2.1 now run in ComfyUI with SGLang Diffusion, which also loads community GGUF checkpoints and LoRAs ([#43504](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43504), [#43581](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43581), [#42556](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42556), [#39523](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39523), [#42174](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42174)).
* Important fix: Hybrid linear models could resume from wrong mamba states when speculative decoding and structured output were used together. Thanks to [@Wirick](https://github.com/Wirick) and Baseten for finding it ([#43029](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43029)).

## To upgrade

SGLang now requires Python 3.11 or newer.

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.22
```

| Platform | Docker |
|---|---|
| NVIDIA (CUDA 13) | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22` |
| AMD MI35x | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x` |
| AMD MI30x | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi30x` |
| Intel GPU | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-xpu` |
| Intel CPU | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-xeon` |

# Full Release Notes

## Speculative Decoding

* [RL][Spec] Introduce top-p mask capture for spec and add DFlash/DSpark impl: [#34201](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34201)
* [HiSparse] Add speculative decoding support with multi-step KV cache swapping: [#37771](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37771)
* [Kimi-K3][DCP][DSpark] fix eager mode nonetype crash due to no extend_prefix_lens: [#38991](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38991)
* [Spec][PP] Fix hybrid recurrent-state commit and micro-batch pairing under PP x speculative decoding: [#40001](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40001)
* [Spec] Reuse K3 auxiliary outputs across decode CUDA graph sizes: [#40159](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40159)
* [NVIDIA][MegaMoE] Fix the default spec decoding moe backend when the target model uses flashinfer megamoe: [#40772](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40772)
* fix(spec): enable Qwen3.5 EAGLE3 capture and streaming overlap: [#41154](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41154)
* [Qwen3.8-Flash-Next] Fuse QSA graph replay metadata across draft steps: [#41173](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41173)
* [Qwen3.8-Flash-Next] Fuse NEXTN verify and draft graph input preparation: [#41175](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41175)
* [HiSparse] fix: reject speculative decoding and mixed chunk at startup: [#41347](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41347)
* The sgalng api specs: [#41585](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41585)
* [Spec] Dspark support: [#41623](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41623)
* Fix XQA draft extend with FP8 KV cache in trtllm_mha: [#41656](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41656)
* [QSA] Enable breakable prefill CUDA graphs for text-only Qwen3.8 Flash-Next (capture-safe metadata, MTP side-channel padding): [#41729](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41729)
* [DFlash] Keep grouped-conv taps inside each request's block so NaN/Inf cannot leak across requests: [#41736](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41736)
* [DFlash2] Keep the greedy selector walk in range for all-NaN score rows: [#41737](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41737)
* [PD][Spec] Give a PD decode's first EAGLE draft step a proposal distribution: [#41783](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41783)
* [Fix] Pass the draft's attention ownership to DFLASH's eager LiLiCorr scope: [#41808](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41808)
* [Spec] Fix Qwen3.5 text model EAGLE3/DFLASH aux-layer capture: [#42002](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42002)
* [Spec][MegaMoE] Let the speculative draft choose its own W4A4 MXFP4 MegaMoE MMA type: [#42022](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42022)
* [Spec] LiLiCorr: named head MLPs and quantized head linears: [#42057](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42057)
* [Spec] Add opt-in block verification: [#42297](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42297)
* [Fix] Load a draft's tensor weight update from its deployment TP rank: [#42346](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42346)
* [Fix] Skip a draft's decode recapture when it owns no decode graph: [#42347](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42347)
* [Perf] Improve GLM-5.3-Flash DFlash decoding on B300 (decode 1091.9 to 1199.7 tok/s on 8x B300 at concurrency 1): [#42489](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42489)
* [DSpark] Mask uncommitted slots before commit-inject cache lookups: [#42624](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42624)
* Back the DFlash-family draft KV pool to the post-capture token count: [#42651](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42651)
* perf(kda): rebalance MTP verify precompute and state synchronization (verify kernel 13.2 to 9.7 µs on Vera Rubin): [#42683](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42683)
* [Spec] Fix wrong tokens from compact-verify CUDA graphs when a token tier is captured more than once: [#42709](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42709)
* [KDA] Support Helion MTP verification and harden prefill, decode: [#42857](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42857)
* [KDA] Default GLM-5-Next spec verify to the CuTe DSL KDA kernel: [#42905](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42905)
* [DSpark] Fold draft sampling for DeepSeek-V4.1 heads under AUTO: [#42987](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42987)
* [Spec] Support block verification for the DFlash family: [#43012](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43012)
* [Scheduler] Use committed length in spec mamba track boundary check (found by [@Wirick](https://github.com/Wirick) at Baseten): [#43029](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43029)
* [Spec] Allow Qwen3.5 backends to opt into packed target verification: [#43037](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43037)
* [DFlash] Build the attention QKV projection through an overridable hook: [#43179](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43179)
* [DSpark] Run every markov head through one step interface: [#43620](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43620)
* [DSpark] Add `MarkovSampleStep`, one op for a markov draft step's add and token pick: [#43621](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43621)
* [DSpark] Draft the eager markov block through `MarkovSampleStep`: [#43622](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43622)
* [DSpark] Run the same markov block in the draft graph tail; drop `SGLANG_DSPARK_FOLDED_SAMPLING`: [#43668](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43668)
* [DSpark] Merge the draft TP sync sites into `dspark-draft`: [#43669](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43669)
* [DSpark] Add `SGLANG_DSPARK_USE_GREEDY_DRAFT`, an argmax draft accepted as one-hot: [#43670](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43670)
* [DeepSeek-V4.1] Admit the NIXL transfer backend for DSpark PD: [#43734](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43734)
* [DSpark] Share draft params, logits dtype, confidence and the accept tail between graph and eager: [#43790](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43790)

## Breakable CUDA Graph

* [Fix] Llama4 local attention: read page ids from the graph tables in CUDA-graph capture/replay (page_size > 1): [#38187](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38187)
* [BCG][DeepSeek-V4-Flash][CP] Support DeepSeek V4 prefill with interleave CP and breakable CUDA graphs: [#38603](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38603)
* fix(cuda-graph): remove unnecessary CP batch alignment: [#40543](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40543)
* [GLM-5.3-Flash] Capture the KDA extend in breakable prefill CUDA graphs: [#41105](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41105)
* Drop the GLM-5.3-Flash breakable prefill chunk-size pin: [#41837](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41837)
* [Fix] MiniMax-M3: default to the breakable prefill CUDA graph: [#41845](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41845)
* Size the VMM graph-input exchange by the widest input across ranks: [#42125](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42125)
* [DSA] Fix pooled page table refresh for target verify CUDA graph replay: [#42750](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42750)

items.aiSummary: A reinforcement learning framework, RECAP, optimizes context compaction by aligning compressed-context behavior with original-history behavior, improving long-horizon agent performance.
items.abstract: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent's subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that RECAP consistently outperforms the task-reward-only RL baselines on both environments, leading to an absolute improvement of 4.6% and 4.3% on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified, respectively. Ablations further highlight the value of jointly supervising summary generation and post-compaction behavior for RECAP.

# v0.32.0

## Highlights

This release features 814 commits from 363 contributors (121 new)!

* **Structured decisions and generic parsers**: the new `POST /v1/systemone` endpoint answers `choice`, `noul` and `score` questions over a structured state (#59299), is served by default (#60677, #60696), and also runs on `Cloudflare/clef-omni` (#61064), `LiquidAI/d1-3B` (#60676) and DiffusionGemma (#60466). The new `hf` tool and reasoning parser (`--tool-call-parser hf`, `--reasoning-parser hf`) reads the checkpoint's `response_template`, so models that ship it need no model-specific parser (#58604, #58602), in both the Python and Rust frontends (#59005).
* **Low-precision KV cache everywhere**: NVFP4 KV cache now runs on SM8x and SM12x (#46963), SM90 (#60620) and with XQA decode on SM12x (#60452), and on MiniMax-M3 sparse attention on SM100 (#59300); GLM-5.x defaults to an FP8 KV cache on SM100, halving KV memory per rank with 2.3-5.5% more throughput at a 7-11% TTFT cost in the PR's benchmark (#60140, #60281); `fp8_ds_mla` on SM90 gives GLM-5.3-Flash up to 31% more output throughput (#59246); ROCm gains the 4-bit `ultraquant_4bit` KV cache with about 2x the density of FP8 (#57057).
* **Model Runner V2**: a GPU n-gram speculator with variable-length drafts (#40704), Elastic EP (#53934), pipeline parallelism with prefill context parallelism for MLA models (#59139), a stock torch.compile mode (#59079), and MRV2 is now the default on ROCm with the model-specific MRV1 exceptions removed (#56360).
* **Faster startup and serving**: `vllm download-kernels` installs FlashInfer's precompiled kernels (#58765); `vllm preload --preload-autotune` keeps the FlashInfer autotune table warm across restarts (#60085); a shared-memory tensor arena broadcasts large multimodal tensors to workers with one copy (#51207); tokenizers and processors load from the local snapshot (#60825); and with `--api-server-count` above 1 each connection goes to the least-loaded API worker, for 43-85% more req/s on short requests (Qwen3-0.6B, 32 input / 1 output tokens) in the PR's benchmark (#60723).
* **Model support**: new EmbeddingGemma 2 omni-modal embeddings (#60254), MiniCPM-V 4.7 (#58674) and Nemotron 3.5 ASR (#59827); video input in the Transformers modeling backend (#57441); GLM-5.3 sparse MLA index conversions reused across layers (3.5-3.9x on that kernel, #59464) and fused multi-step draft decode (13.3% at concurrency 1, #57443); HiSparse per-request residency caching for up to 58% more throughput on GLM-5.3-NVFP4 on B200 with long, fully GPU-resident contexts at high concurrency (#60083).
* **Security**: fixes for GHSA-4hhp-h66f-j5j7 (chat template resource exhaustion, #50300), GHSA-q97c-p368-75c4 (tokenizer `max_token_id`, #59491) and GHSA-frvg-qw88-hww9 (P2P ZMQ socket exhaustion, #51504); CORS no longer allows every origin by default (#61009); untrusted images are limited to raster formats (#60022); shared-memory multimodal cache handles are signed (#59357); and JSON schemas nested deeper than 64 levels are rejected (#60036).
* **Breaking changes**: Python 3.10 dropped (#60402); default CORS origins restricted (#61009); `transformers>=5.16.1,<5.20.0` and `tokenizers>=0.23.2` (#57387, #59796); torch.compile sequence parallelism and AsyncTP passes removed (#60517); cascade attention removed (#61126); `mamba_cache_mode="all"` removed (#58997); `max_tokens` no longer reserved from the context window (#57035); Responses API reasoning stream events renamed (#59652).

## Release Artifacts

### Python Wheels

| Platform | Install |
|---|---|
| PyPI (CUDA 13.0) | `pip install vllm` |
| PyPI (CUDA 13.0, uv) | `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend=auto` |
| ROCm | `pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.32.0/rocm723` |
| XPU | `uv pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/0.32.0/xpu --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu --index-strategy unsafe-best-match` |

### Docker Images

| Platform | Docker Image |
|---|---|
| CUDA 13.0 (Default) | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0` |
| CUDA 12.9 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129` |
| CUDA 13.0 + Ubuntu 24.04 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-ubuntu2404` |
| CUDA 12.9 + Ubuntu 24.04 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129-ubuntu2404` |
| ROCm | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.32.0` |
| CPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:v0.32.0` |
| XPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:v0.32.0` |

### Other Artifacts

Pre-built release artifacts are available in the **Assets** section at the bottom of this page, including:
- Source distribution tarball
- CUDA 12.9 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64
- CUDA 13.0 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64
- CPU Python wheels for x86_64, arm64, and macOS
- XPU Python wheel for x86_64

## Model Support
* **New models**: EmbeddingGemma 2 (`google/embeddinggemma-2`), an omni-modal text/image/audio/video embedding model, with unused modality encoders skipped through `--limit-mm-per-prompt` (#60254, #60289); MiniCPM-V 4.7 (#58674); Nemotron 3.5 ASR (`nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b`) complete-audio transcription; native realtime streaming is not yet supported (#59827); `Cloudflare/clef-omni` (#61064) and `LiquidAI/d1-3B` (#60676) on `/v1/systemone`; PLaMo 3 reasoning and tool parsers (#56575); and the zerank-2 reranker score template (#60415).
* **Transformers modeling backend**: video inputs (#57441), and Glm, Arcee, CWM, Mellum (#59679), GPT-NeoX, Phi, Seed-OSS and Jais2 (#59701) now served through it.
* **New model capabilities**: LoRA for BERT, RoBERTa and XLM-RoBERTa embedding models (#61033); Granite as an EAGLE3/DFlash target (#60855); Qwen3-ASR EAGLE3 (#52824); Sarvam MLA EAGLE3/DSpark with PP (#55902); GLM-5.3-Flash with the DFlash2 drafter (#56983); and MiniMax-M3 EAGLE3 at PP > 1 on MRV2 (#57197) with MTP sharing target embeddings under PP (#58648).
* **GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash**: sparse MLA index conversion reused across layers (#59464), fused multi-step draft decode (#57443), FP8 KV cache default on SM100 (#60140, #60281), `fp8_ds_mla` on SM90 (#59246), qlnorm skipped for MHA (4.4-7.7% TTFT, #58845), long-context indexer prefill sharded across TP (up to 25% lower TTFT at 1M context, #54951), DCP for the kpool indexer (#59211, #60032), KDA prefill checkpoints with FlashKDA (#56960), FP8 KV on SM90 sparse MLA (#55222), `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` honored for KDA state (#59147), a generic packed KV layout (#57169), MTP index sharing restored (#61079), and fixes for vision-tower crashes (#59126), non-square image encoder budgets (#59565), DP startup (#56974), video timestamps (#55647), DFlash2/EAGLE3 aux hidden states (#60763) and null-block writes (#59528).
* **DeepSeek-V4 and V4.1**: decoder-side SWA bounded replay (#58132) with replay layers in CUDA graphs and trimmed in PIECEWISE graphs (`compilation_config.decoder_replay_trim_threshold`, #59532) plus last KV-source layer trimming (+3.6%, #59894), packed FP8 Engram exchange across DP (#59923), faster CPU-offloaded Engram lookups (#59327), fused DeepSeek V4 + MTP drafting (#58463), encoder CUDA graph packing for V4.1 and Kimi-K3 (11% lower mean TTFT, #58925), EPLB for DSpark drafts (#57549), and fixes for NVFP4 checkpoints with 0% draft acceptance (#59655), MegaMoE shared-expert finalize ordering (#59927), worst-case vision dummy inputs (#57898, #59271), compressor ring null-block writes (#58560), Triton 3.9 indexer quantization (#60716) and decoder-replay CUDA graphs with FlashInfer EP MoE backends (#61041).
* **Qwen**: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Qwen4Exp) merged QSA projections in one GEMM (1.45-1.68x, #59533), fused QSA pre-indexer (#57097), sequence parallelism through `--enable-hc-sp` (#56322), SM100 low-latency decode GEMM plans (up to 2.7x vs cuBLAS on small-M, #59214), `--kv-cache-dtype-skip-layers` honored (#60023), and PLE loading for INC (#59990), Quark (#59443) and pre-SM89 GPUs (#60142); Qwen3-VL/Qwen3.5/Qwen3.8 M-RoPE cache 4x smaller and Qwen3.5 YaRN matching Transformers (#59853); Qwen3-Omni M-RoPE fixes (#58890, #59842); Qwen3-ASR on the upstream processor (#57146); Qwen3-VL unknown video fps (#60501) and per-video options with the multimodal cache (#55203).
* **Kimi-K3 and MiniMax-M3**: Kimi-K3 FlashInfer fused speculative KDA on SM100 (#54255), fused vision processor (10-20x preprocessing at 1080p-8K, #59278), fused K/V pack on the DCP prefill path (#56881), and DSpark KV cache back to 4 groups (#59733); MiniMax-M3 MSA prefill with an E4M3 query (26-37% faster with FP8 KV, #60684), FP8 indexer cache on non-SM100 GPUs (#59081), Triton indexer tuning (#56151, #59481), and indexer score fixes (#60194, #54597).
* **Multimodal**: device-side input normalization for Qwen3-VL/Qwen3.5/Qwen4Exp (#51289), GLM-V and GLM-OCR (#55389), Llama Nemotron VL (#57928) and Kimi K2.5/K3 (#59278), kept fused under `compile_mm_encoder` (#59195); encoder inputs sorted by modality (6.5-8.2% more req/s, #60196); Mistral 3 preprocessing 8% faster (#57531); Pixtral `compile_mm_encoder` (#57168); and fixes for Llama 4 / Mistral Large 3 EAGLE drafters (regression since v0.28.0, #57633), Phi-4 MM audio OOM (#60614), DeepSeek-OCR zero-sum pixels (#59417), MiMo-V2.5/V2.6 with fastsafetensors (#58142), MiMo-V2.6 FP8 KV cache (#58128), Voxtral realtime (#45022), Nemotron Super vision LayerNorm (#61401), K-EXAONE config and MTP RoPE (#60187), Nemotron Parse tied `lm_head` (#60272), LongCat-Flash MTP loading (#60080) and Ling-3.0-flash-VL (#59026).

## Engine Core
* **Model Runner V2**: GPU n-gram speculator (#40704), Elastic EP with drain-then-commit scaling (#53934), PP with PCP for MLA models (#59139), `STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE` mode (#59079), dynamic K in autoregressive speculators (#57053), MTP sampling-mask replay (#59359) and per-module LM heads (#58921), non-blocking H2D copies on WSL2 (#60215), and fixes for int64 index offsets at long context (#60736), warmup (#61013), GDN prefill checkpoints (#59536) and MRV2+PP+MTP align state (#60210).
* **Speculative decoding**: fused multi-step draft decode on FlashInfer trtllm-gen (#58371), FlashInfer ReplaySSM for Mamba2 MTP (#52928), in-graph metadata for DFlash/DSpark drafts (#60692), and correctness fixes for ngram on hybrid recurrent models (#56531), Mamba prefill checkpoints with MTP and prefix caching (#59759, #60797), stop-string trimming (#47616), draft model config (#61240), adaptive block verification (#60945), DSpark bonus slots (#59105) and draft models on the Transformers backend (#59293).
* **Hybrid models and prefix caching**: Mamba2 internal prefill checkpoints for NemotronH, Granite-4.0-H, Falcon-H1 and Zamba2 (#57329), stale block hashes dropped when streaming sessions truncate (#59103), and fixes for quantized Mamba-2 with TP (#58083), spec decode page sizes (#59975), prefix-cache bounds (#55601, #60533) and sm90 Mamba2 NaNs (#61718).
* **Sleep and RL**: sleep releases workspace scratch (up to 4.5 GiB/GPU, #59156) and KV-init state (about 4.6 GiB/GPU, #59158), opt-in `sleep_mode_offload_cudagraph` (#59160, #59523); token-level weight-version spans on outputs (#59582, #61070); weight-transfer communicators released without stopping inference (#61060); `--sleep-preserve-parameter-names 'draft.*'` (#61046); `modelexpress` weight-transfer backend (#58399); `POST /weight_checker` (#51350); weight-transfer metrics (#55781); `--enable-nccl-comm-suspend` releasing the MNNVL workspace (#59360); and `sleep(level=2)` keeping FP8 KV scales (#57163).
* **HiSparse**: per-request residency cache (up to 58% at high concurrency with GPU-resident contexts, #60083), lower scheduler overhead (#57930), GPU residency owned by HiSparse (#60647), less staging memory (#60429), host cache gauges (#58949, #59485), and fixes for decode token limits (#60682) and TP hangs (#60941).
* **Startup and memory**: shared-memory tensor arena (`--enable-shm-tensor-arena`, on by default, #51207), Fast Start with PP (#55477), daemon-held weights counted against `gpu_memory_utilization` (#57298), autotune preload (#60085), local tokenizer snapshots (#60825), `sparse_mla_prefill_workspace_factor` saving several GiB at 1M context (#61023), cached memory reclaimed during weight loading (#57516), fewer Triton sampler warmup compiles (#58605), sharded state loader with PP (#52110), and `reload_weights` with Run:ai streamer (#58124).
* **Kernels and runtime**: MoE weighted-sum tuning (1.17-2.37x, #59731), flash-maxsim kernels for ColBERT/ColPali scoring (#40337), fallback detokenization with 69% less CPU at 32K tokens (#60497), faster KV block free queue (#60269), Triton kernels off `tl.make_block_ptr` (#60502), fusion passes restored under PyTorch 2.15 (#57299) and static FP8 quant fusion on recent torch (#61108).
* **Batch invariance**: custom all-reduce under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1` (#58623), deterministic split-K LoRA shrink (#59377), every attention backend checked (#60271), SM120 TP configs (#58495), and ROCm support (#52231).
* **Observability**: `vllm:prompt_tokens_cached_by_source_total` (#56318), `vllm:num_requests_kv_fetch_by_stage` (#58874), `vllm:admission_rejections_total` (#55812), `vllm:watermark_requests` (#58715), `--custom-histogram-buckets` (#48867), a JSON log formatter via `LoggingConfig.formatter` (#58739), and per-session profiling controls (#57875).

## Large Scale Serving
* **MoE communication**: FlashInfer CuteDSL MegaMoE for more models via `--moe-backend flashinfer_cutedsl` (#54049), FP8 combine for the FlashInfer one-sided all2all (+4% at DEP8, #57995), NCCL symmetric-memory MoE reduce-scatter (9.6-16% lower latency, #49194), DeepEPv2 hybrid NVLink+RDMA mode on by default (#57991), Kimi-K3 shared experts with DeepEP v2 (#56875), and opt-in EPLB migration batching (#52641).
* **Context parallelism**: decode requests sharded across PCP ranks (#52162) and TokenSpeed MLA with block-interleaved DCP for heterogeneous NIXL disaggregation (#59462).
* **KV connectors**: NIXL host-buffer copies coalesced (#54483), mixed block sizes (#58860), peer metadata recovery (#55471) and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MTP acceptance in P/D (#59997); Mooncake coalesced hybrid/MLA RDMA regions (#57952) and bootstrap retries (#55923); MoRIIO Kimi-K3 DSpark READ (#57700); DeepSeek-V4.1 P/D skipping bounded replay for loaded KV (#59197); and KVCR pool-and-index API (#59899).
* **Data parallelism**: streaming requests pinned to their engine (#59017), per-engine RNG streams (#59788), and placement groups without `ray[default]` (#57648).

## Hardware & Performance
* **NVIDIA**: native 64-head FlashMLA sparse prefill on SM100 (1.16-1.18x TTFT, #60029), block-FP8 DeepGEMM experts skipping padding (#59128), SM120 split-K attention (#58482), DGX Spark Qwen4Exp GEMM plans (#59753, #59632, #60027), OAI Triton MXFP4 MoE on SM12x (#58877), and FlashInfer autotune cache per rank (#57635).
* **AMD ROCm**: DeepSeek-V4 AITER MegaMoEV2 via `--moe-backend aiter_mega_moe` (#59685) with opt-in shared-expert fusion (3-8%, #61004), opt-in mono decode for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on MI355X (`VLLM_ROCM_MONO_DECODE=1`, #60397), opt-in Gluon sparse MLA (up to +16% on GLM-5.2, #53492), paged MXFP4 indexer (#58671), opt-in a4w4 MoE for DSv4 (#58819), `ultraquant_4bit` KV cache (#57057), `aiter_flydsl` GDN prefill (#57560), Kimi-K3 prefill checkpoints (about 20% better TTFT, #58344), fused MLA decode (#57640) and per-rank latent MoE shards (#59591), GLM-5.3-Flash split-K sparse MLA decode (5-15% lower ITL, #58584), native `merge_attn_states` (2.4x, #60159), `ROCM_SEGMENTED_ATTN` for RDNA (#59132), gfx11 W4A16 tuning (up to 23% TTFT, #56301), MRV2 default with model-specific MRV1 exceptions removed (#56360), and fixes for sleep-mode segfaults on ROCm 7.2+ (#60367) and MLA weight reloads (#60389).
* **Intel XPU**: MLA in `FLASH_ATTN_MLA` (#58297), Arc Pro B70 FP8 GEMM (2.0-2.73x, #56063) and fused MoE configs (#53065), fused SYCL LayerNorm (#57172), and fixes for Gemma-2 softcap (#589

# Highlights

*779 PRs from 227 contributors.*

## New models

| Model | Type | Cookbook |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1) |
| GigaChat 3.5 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/GigaChat/GigaChat3.5) |
| IQuest-Q1 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/IQuestLab/IQuest-Q1) |
| MiMo-V2.6 / MiMo-V2.6-Pro | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Xiaomi/MiMo-V2.6) |
| Ling-3.0-flash-VL | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/InclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL) |
| DiffusionGemma | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Google/DiffusionGemma) |
| Qwen-Image 2.1 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Qwen-Image/Qwen-Image-2.1) |
| Anima Base v1.0 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/CircleStone/Anima) |
| Ming-Image 0.1 Design / Design-Layer | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/inclusionAI/Ming-Image) |
| FLUX 3 Action | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/vla/FLUX/FLUX-3-Action) |

## Key features

* PD instances can switch between prefill and decode on the fly, no restart needed ([#28403](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28403)).
* The prefix cache now runs on a Rust core by default ([#39627](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39627)).
* DeepSeek-V4.1 gets 22% faster first token on long prompts ([#40352](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40352)).
* Kimi K3 gets 20.6% higher prefill throughput in PD serving ([#40045](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40045)).
* GLM-5.3-Flash now runs on AMD MI355X, with FP8 / MXFP4 MoE and MTP speculative decoding ([#38546](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38546), [#39341](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39341), [#39778](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39778)).
* More accurate results under PP, DP attention, and CP, with layer communication now handled by SGLang ([guide](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/layer_boundary), [#41557](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41557)).
* New Decisions API (`/v1/decisions`) turns an LLM / VLM into a low-latency classifier and scorer ([docs](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/supported-models/decision_models), [#41208](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41208)).
* Score API (`/v1/score`) scores all candidates in one request ([#38965](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38965), [#41188](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41188)).
* Run MiniMax-H3 with SGLang Diffusion inside ComfyUI ([#35990](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35990)).

## To upgrade

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.21
```

| Platform | Docker |
|---|---|
| NVIDIA (CUDA 13) | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21) |
| AMD MI35x | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x) |
| AMD MI30x | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi30x`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-rocm10-mi30x) |
| Intel GPU | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-xpu`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-xpu) |
| Intel CPU | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-xeon`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-xeon) |

# Full Release Notes

## Speculative Decoding

* Pipeline parallelism x speculative decoding (EAGLE/MTP) compatibility: [#30775](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30775)
* Support XQA backend for SpecDec verify: [#32269](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32269)
* [Spec] Windowed draft-decode attention for built-in EAGLE / MTP drafts: [#32673](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32673)
* Avoid materializing GDN QKV tensors during target verification: [#33778](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33778)
* [Spec] Fix CDF boundary handling in `TreeSpeculativeSamplingTargetOnly`: [#35798](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35798)
* [Spec] Add LiLiCorr: a candidate-lattice reranker for DFlash drafts: [#37462](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37462)
* Add out-of-tree DFlash extension points: [#38740](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38740)
* [Spec] Add explicit prefill shared-read capability for plugins: [#39502](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39502)
* [Fix] Don't write conv state from the fused KDA verify kernel: [#39524](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39524)
* [Spec] Model-agnostic last-stage draft embedding under pipeline parallelism: [#39643](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39643)
* Use runtime token widths for Triton speculative verification: [#39859](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39859)
* avoid host sync in DSpark prefill slot expansion: [#40111](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40111)
* [Experimental] Preserve speculative decoding during prefill across DP ranks: [#40118](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40118)
* [Spec][PP] Launch extend microbatches before the spec output exchange: [#40499](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40499)
* [KDA] Enable ReplaySSM for GLM-5.3 Flash: [#40517](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40517)
* [LFM2-VL] Add DSpark speculative decoding (1.66x to 2.56x speedup at batch 1): [#40651](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40651)
* [Spec] Support DFLASH for Kimi K3: [#40794](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40794)
* [Fix] Reduce Nemotron MTP attention outputs once: [#40800](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40800)
* [Fix] Capture complete Nemotron auxiliary hidden states: [#40801](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40801)
* [Fix] Skip the DCP target-verify MLA kernel during FlashInfer autotune: [#41138](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41138)
* Fix mixed chunk prefill with DP speculative coordination: [#41179](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41179)
* [Fix] Plan NextN / MTP draft layers as one-layer models and fix the Bailing V2 NextN draft: [#41194](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41194)

## Piecewise & Breakable CUDA Graph

* [Fix] Preserve model runner contracts in prefill CUDA graphs: [#35452](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35452)
* [DSV4][BCG] Optimize the heavy memory use of C4 Indexer when BCG is enabled (capture memory down 58% to 18 GB): [#36534](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36534)
* [Fix] Don't free the multi-CTAs KV counter the decode graphs captured: [#39175](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39175)
* [CPU] Avoid prefill CP predicates during decode graph capture: [#39690](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39690)
* [Runtime] Add decode CUDA graph hooks for eager logits processing: [#40222](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40222)
* [Kimi K3] Fix CUDA graph stream explosion: [#40640](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40640)
* [DSpark] Fix draft CUDA graph stream explosion: [#40658](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40658)
* [Fix] Give the full prefill CUDA graph replay view the captured bucket's input_ids: [#40851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40851)
* [DSA] Fix the pooled-indexer breakable prefill bridge under DP attention: [#41311](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41311)

## Attention Backends

* Allow attention layers to opt out of the prefill wrapper: [#40683](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40683)
* [Fix] Use cached prefix lengths for FlashInfer full-attention ragged prefill: [#40796](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40796)

## MoE & Expert Parallelism

* [3/N] elastic-ep: Recapture decode CUDA graphs after scale-up: [#33723](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33723)
* Fix int4 MoE tuner config filename: [#35260](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35260)
* [MegaMoE] Wire Qwen MoE blocks to DeepGEMM MegaMoE (MXFP4 and NVFP4 experts): [#38080](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38080)
* [Feature] Support BF16 and batch-invariant inference with DeepEP v2: [#38160](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38160)
* [Perf] Optimize w4a8 MoE for glm5.2 on H200: [#38220](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38220)
* [Fix] Guard FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE against 0-token inputs: [#38780](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38780)
* [Kernel] Add H20 block-FP8 MoE configs for GLM-5.3-Flash EP4/EP8: [#38913](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38913)
* Accept MXFP8 dispatch in FlashInfer A2A TRT-LLM MoE: [#39613](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39613)
* [MoE] Honor swiglu_limit clamped activation in flashinfer_cutlass runner: [#39939](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39939)
* Support MXFP8 and deferred route weighting in DeepEP v2: [#40030](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40030)
* [MoE] Disable FlashInfer fused finalize by default for numerical accuracy: [#40105](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40105)
* [Fix] Fix top-1 MoE routing with non-unit scaling: [#40187](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40187)
* [DeepEP v2] support GLM-5.3-Flash (Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration): [#40466](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40466)
* [Fix] Decide the MoE padded-row bound from the layer scatter mode: [#40672](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40672)
* [DeepEP v2] Let a model package supply its per-rank prefill dispatch bound: [#41201](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41201)

## Quantization

* [MXFP8-KV] Skip writes to the reserved CUDA-graph padding slot: [#35351](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35351)
* feat(kv-cache): support SM100 NVFP4 GenMHA and speculative decoding (1.355x faster decode attention kernel at 1M context): [#36340](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36340)
* [Quant] ModelOpt mixed precision: dispatch block-FP8 MoE experts and derive the block size: [#38726](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38726)
* fix(modelopt): dispatch NVFP4 MoE on the cached backend, not the live global: [#38932](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38932)
* [Quant] Serve 32-wide-K ue8m0 block-FP8 linears through the FlashInfer MXFP8 GEMMs: [#40039](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40039)
* [ModelOpt][PP] Keep BF16 shared experts out of the NVFP4 fusion so TP1 pipeline stages can load: [#40628](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40628)

## Parallelism & Disaggregation

* [PD] Introduce runtime role switching between prefill and decode: [#28403](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28403)
* disaggregation: Fix FakeKVSender queue accumulation: [#28652](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28652)
* [PD] Keep EAGLE DP graph and token metadata consistent: [#32196](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32196)
* [NVIDIA][comm] Merge EP+MoE-TP post-experts all-reduces into one _TP reduction: [#32963](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32963)
* Add 8-node AllReduce/AllGather and MNVLS algorithm support to MSCCL++: [#37442](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37442)
* [KV-Shard 2/4] Sharded pools: [#37615](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37615)
* [KV-Shard 3/4] Enable Control plane: [#38468](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38468)
* [KV-Shard 3/4] Enable Control Plane B: [#39964](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39964)
* Fix device context during NIXL backend initialization: [#38774](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38774)
* [PD] Do not admit intake-rejected requests to a PD handoff: [#38935](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38935)
* Reduce decode bootstrap latency with request-owned speculative KV (mean TTFT 19.4 to 15.1 s on DeepSeek-V4-Pro 1P1D, MI355X, concurrency 256): [#38978](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38978)
* Fix disagg PP MTP for GLM-5.2: [#39378](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39378)
* [PD] Add optional KV transfer checksums: [#39500](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39500)
* [DCP] Use logical token capacity for PD admission and load reporting: [#39731](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39731)
* Refactor the Cute-DSL AR fusion to support DeepseekV2 archs (GLM-5.3, etc.): [#39816](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39816)
* [PD] Validate Mooncake EFA allocator compatibility: [#39973](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39973)
* [PD] Skip singleton transfer-status all-reduces: [#40003](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40003)
* [PD] Enable optimistic prefill with buffer-only L3 write-through HiCache: [#40043](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40043)
* [Kimi K3][PD] support pp prefill + dcp decode with dspark: [#40045](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40045)
* [PD] Add decode host receive for custom transfer backends: [#40238](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40238)
* [PD] Allow decode radix cache and HiCache L1/L2 with DCP: [#40263](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40263)
* [PD] Enter the custom mem pool once when allocating DCP pack buffers: [#40284](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40284)
* [PD] Bound cached-prefix DCP transfers by pack capacity (cached-prefix throughput about 10.9x higher at concurrency 8 on Kimi Linear, 8x B200): [#40376](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40376)
* [PD] Pack draft KV head slices for DCP transfers: [#40500](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40500)
* [PD] Preserve abort ACKs until in-flight KV transfers drain: [#40645](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40645)
* Fix NIXL transfer of MXFP8 KV block scales: [#40792](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40792)
* [PD] Honor gracefully_exit in disaggregation event loops and keep non-zero-rank launchers alive on SIGTERM: [#40793](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40793)
* [DP Attention] Publish DP buffer sizes from a ForwardBatch: [#40858](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40858)
* [PD] Enable deferred decode-side KV release by default: [#41023](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41023)
* [PD] Add a `none` decode retraction backup and subclass seams in the PD queues: [#41103](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41103)
* [PD] fix: cache resumed decode-radix requests from root instead of an unlocked re-match: [#41261](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41261)
* [PD] Fan drain abort ACKs out to every decode peer of the room: [#41402](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41402)
* [PD] Defer decode KV release on every transfer failure, not only decode-initiated aborts: [#41404](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41404)
* [Fix] Stop deferring the last layer's FFN all-reduce in five models: [#40868](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40868)
* [Fix] Complete the deferred FFN all-reduce before a pipeline-parallel send: [#41079](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41079)
* [Fix] Complete the deferred FFN all-reduce before deepstack addition and aux hidden-state capture: [#41080](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41080)
* [Fix] Step-3.5: stop dense layers from summing their output twice under DP attention: [#41082](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41082)
* [Fix] Broadcast requests along attention CP before attention TP: [#41083](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41083)
* [Fix] Complete the all-reduce when the flashinfer fused norm declines a batch: [#41193](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41193)
* [Fix] Stop counting a deferred FFN sum more than once: replicated TP1 shared expert, dense reduce_scatterv: [#41195](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41195)
